oneOf.description: Independent dial actions: turn left, turn right, and press

linked_turns.description: Keep turn-lane editing synchronized without changing independent runtime contexts

user_desired_state.description: Explicit Elgato multi-action state selection; plugin settings stay opaque

size.description: Font size as a percentage of surface height

toggle_icon.description: Alternate icon selected after each successful binding execution

BackgroundSource.description: Selects a background without discarding the saved custom color or media

custom_background.description: Distinguishes an explicit color (including transparent) from the original default

firmware_report.description: Model-specific HID read contract. Omitted means SDK input report 0, 513 bytes

frame_output.description: Implemented experimental paths, not hardware qualification or FPS ratings

image_output_unavailable_reason.description: A source-derived contract could not safely choose the image encoding

media_formats.description: Accepted source assets; animated sources are decoded into image_formats by the runtime

DeviceFramePolicy.description: Rendering policy; host cadence is independent of firmware qualification

device_configuration.description: Explicit neighboring hardware choices; absent until the first review

frame_policy.description: Missing policies use grouped key updates when supported, otherwise frame scheduling

keyboard.description: App preference only. Applied solely by the explicit keyboard command

DirectionalSwitch.description:
A switch has independent left/center/right button edges. Each position owns
a distinct control ID, so simultaneous directions and their releases retain
normal per-control scheduling and held-input ownership.

rect.description: X, Y, width and height, as percentages of the surface

FirmwareReport.description: Read-only version transport; it never sends firmware images or update commands

windows_supported.description: Some independently sourced protocols are explicitly unimplemented on Windows

HidSelector.description:
Discovery predicate, distinct from the actual identity reported by HIDAPI
Omitted interface means any interface; usage pages require an exact value or
an inclusive lower bound. Device/vendor/usage are always exact.

IconAsset.description: The vector and attribution travel with bindings and presets, independently of the disk cache

KeyboardBackgroundColor.description: K1's background command carries hue and saturation only (full value)

effect_names.description: Ordered wire indexes, not the vendor UI's decorative IDs

sleep_timeout_seconds_options.description: Supported firmware idle timers in seconds, including u32::MAX for Never

KeyboardMacroRepeatMode.description: Repeat behavior is explicit saved action intent, never a platform fallback

oneOf.description:
Linux X11 supplies repeats from the user's existing keyboard controls
Recorded Repeat events retain their timing but are not injected

KeyboardSettings.description:
Only explicitly supplied properties are written. These are keyboard outputs,
separate from display brightness and the device's lighting channels.

brightness.description: Keyboard backlight percentage (0..100), independent of LCD brightness

custom_color.description: False selects the device's rainbow palette without forgetting custom RGB

sleep_timeout_seconds.description: Device-managed idle timer; u32::MAX disables timed sleep. Apply-only

profile_family.description: Canonical suggested-profile family; native identities and codecs stay model-owned

PhysicalKey.description: DOM physical codes. Consumer, vendor, Fn and composition keys are absent

control_types.description: Normalized application control kinds declared by the package's controller metadata

state_names.description: Manifest state labels in index order (not the mutable current state)

supported_in_key_logic_actions.description: Elgato key-logic eligibility, separate from multi-action eligibility

supported_in_multi_actions.description: Vendor manifest defaults are true when the flag is omitted

vendor_profile.description: Source-backed per-state title appearance from a bundled vendor profile

last_wake_reason.description: Last admitted start in this Manager session; retains only categorical reasons

TouchPanelCapabilities.description: Host routing capabilities, independent of physical firmware qualification

VendorProfileAppearance.description: Current owned representation, distinct from the external archive format

configuration_fields.description: Other fields that the same hardware command must write explicitly
